Build Volcano Plot Data

Source: R/plot_volcano_enhanced.R
build_volcano_plot_data.Rd

Internal helper that prepares one-contrast volcano plotting data, labels, and color mappings.

Usage

build_volcano_plot_data(
  diff_dat,
  label_col,
  change_colname,
  signif_colname,
  contrast_idx,
  use_custom_lab,
  change_lfc_name,
  change_sig_name,
  value_to_sort_the_output_dataset,
  label_significant_features_only,
  signif_threshold,
  change_threshold,
  num_features_to_label,
  custom_gene_list,
  label_features,
  default_label_color,
  custom_label_color,
  color_of_non_significant_features,
  color_of_logfold_change_threshold_line,
  color_of_features_meeting_only_signif_threshold,
  color_for_features_meeting_pvalue_and_foldchange_thresholds
)

Arguments

diff_dat

Differential-expression results as a data frame.

label_col

Name of the label/feature ID column in diff_dat.

change_colname

Character vector of logFC column names, one per contrast (e.g. c("B-A_logFC", "C-A_logFC")). Defaults to NULL, which auto-detects all columns ending in _logFC.

signif_colname

Character vector of significance column names, one per contrast (e.g. c("B-A_adjpval", "C-A_adjpval")). Defaults to NULL, which auto-detects corresponding columns by checking for _adjpval first, then _pval, for each contrast in change_colname.

contrast_idx

Index of the contrast currently being processed.

use_custom_lab

If TRUE, uses custom labels for the plot (set by change_sig_name and change_lfc_name)

change_lfc_name

Name for the fold change column in the plot. Default is "log2FC".

change_sig_name

Name for the significance column in the plot. Default is "p-value".

value_to_sort_the_output_dataset

How to sort the output dataset. Options are "fold-change", "p-value", or "t-statistic".

label_significant_features_only

If TRUE, automatic labels are selected only from features that pass both the significance and fold-change thresholds.

signif_threshold

Numeric significance threshold (p-value or adjusted p-value cutoff). Features meet this threshold when their value is less than the cutoff (exclusive). Default: 0.05

change_threshold

Numeric value specifying the fold change cutoff for significance (i.e. filters on change_colname). Features meet this threshold when the absolute value is greater than the cutoff (exclusive). Default: 1.0

num_features_to_label

Number of top features/genes to label in the volcano plot. Default is 30.

custom_gene_list

comma-separated string of feature names or IDs to include in the volcano plot.

label_features

If TRUE, only the features specified in custom_gene_list will be used for labeling in the volcano plot, ignoring the top features.

default_label_color

Set the color for the text used to add feature labels to points.

custom_label_color

Set the color for labels from custom_gene_list.

color_of_non_significant_features

Color of the non-significant features.

color_of_logfold_change_threshold_line

Color of the features that meet only the log fold change threshold.

color_of_features_meeting_only_signif_threshold

Color of the features that meet only the significance threshold.

color_for_features_meeting_pvalue_and_foldchange_thresholds

Color of the features that meet both the p-value and fold change thresholds.
